{"files":[{"path":"storyscenes/mini_adventures/kite/reference_story.md","content":"# Before the Curtain: The Storm Costume

At three o’clock, the school hall smelled of dust, warm paint, and the oranges someone had packed for the cast. Ada had been asked to help in the costume cupboard because she remembered where everything belonged. She liked being trusted with the list and the keys. Jo came in carrying a folded script. “They promised me Storm,” she said. “I learned the lines on the bus.” On the rail, Jo found a gold tunic marked MOON. She tried it over her shirt; it pulled tight at the shoulders. Ada found a handwritten label underneath: JO—STORM, crossed out in blue pen.

“Maybe they changed the casting,” Ada said, though the page still listed Jo as Storm. Jo looked at the tunic’s narrow seam. “They didn’t tell me.” She wasn’t crying; she sounded much more annoyed than that. Ada knew the feeling. For weeks she had been trusted to cue the wind in the play, and she wanted the show to work exactly as rehearsed. “I can find Mrs Bell,” she said. Jo handed her the script. “Ask why first. Don’t ask them to give me some other part.” Ada nodded. She put the script on the counter, not in the pile marked returned.

A mirror leaned against a box of paper stars. Its glass was hazy with fingerprints. Ada wiped one clean patch with her sleeve, and Jo stood there holding up the gold tunic. In the mirror, the label on the rail was visible over Jo’s shoulder: STORM, then the blue line through her name. “I look like the Moon,” Jo said. “A very uncomfortable moon.” Ada laughed, then stopped. “You still want to play Storm?” “More than I want to wear this.” Jo’s answer was quick. Ada felt relieved that she didn’t have to guess what help meant.

On a nearby hook hung a long black cape from last year’s play. Ada borrowed it from the cupboard, careful to write her name on the return card. She held it out and Jo swept one corner through the air. It made a soft, convincing rush. “That’s the wind cue,” Ada said. “You could wear it.” Jo shook her head. “You need it for your cue. If you give it to me, you’re the one who loses something.” Ada had planned to carry it herself anyway. She tried it once more, this time making a gust that lifted the paper stars. Jo smiled despite herself.

A loose silver ribbon lay in the notions drawer. Jo tied it to the cape’s clasp, not to the tunic. “So the storm has a little moonlight,” she said. The detail was small, but it was her choice. Ada checked the clock. Mrs Bell was helping the younger class with their painted scenery, and the first audience would arrive soon. “I’ll go ask.” “Ask,” Jo repeated. “Not decide for me.” Ada promised she would come straight back with an answer, even if it was an answer neither of them liked.

Mrs Bell appeared in the doorway, holding a stack of scenery boards. Ada showed her the crossed-out label and asked about the storm costume. Mrs Bell frowned. “The right coat is still in the assembly hall. I sent someone for it, but it may not get here before places.” Jo didn’t hide behind Ada. “I was promised Storm,” she said. “The tunic hurts, and I’m not changing parts without being asked.” Mrs Bell apologized for the label, then hurried back to the hall. The promised coat might still come, but no one could make it arrive by wishing.

Ada and Jo examined the tunic. One seam had a little allowance, but the pin tin was empty. Ada began, “If we just—” Jo pulled the fabric away from her shoulder. “No pinning me into it. I want to be in the play, not pretend it fits.” Ada’s hands stopped. She had wanted to fix the problem quickly, before the cue list became late. Now she saw that a tidy costume was not the same as helping Jo. “Then we keep your part,” she said. “We change how the storm looks.” Jo looked at the cape, then at Ada. “Together?” “Together.”

They moved behind the side curtain to rehearse. Ada held the borrowed cape by its corners, and Jo stood on the other side. The work lamp threw their shapes onto a blank scenery cloth. Jo spoke her Storm lines from behind the moving black shape, deepening her voice on the thunder words. Ada swept the cape once, then waited for Jo’s cue instead of guessing. The silver ribbon flashed at the clasp. It was not the costume they had expected, but the wind had somewhere to go, and Jo’s voice filled the space.

When the play began, the Moon crossed the painted sky in its proper gold tunic. Then the stage went quiet. Jo’s voice said, “Listen—the weather is turning.” Ada raised the cape. Its shadow rolled across the scenery, and the silver ribbon caught the work light like a thin lightning streak. Jo spoke the Storm’s lines, clear and steady. From the front row, Mrs Bell watched with both hands clasped. Ada remembered to let Jo’s words lead the wind.

After the final bow, Jo came offstage grinning. “That was Storm,” she said. “It was,” Ada answered. Mrs Bell apologized again, this time without making an excuse, and promised to correct the cast list before the next performance. Ada carried the cape back to its hook; it had done real work for the scene, and she returned it with the ribbon safely untied. Jo put the script in her own bag. “Next time,” she said, “we check the label together.” Ada handed her the silver ribbon to keep. The curtain was down, but Jo had not been made smaller to fit the wrong costume."},{"path":"storyscenes/mini_adventures/kite/scene_inventory.json","content":"{

"},{"path":"storyscenes/mini_adventures/kite/world.py","content":""""A costume-cupboard adventure with guarded local plays and persistent state.

Run with ``python -m storyscenes.mini_adventures.kite.world --seed 0 --scenes 8``.
No network calls or runtime language models are used.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
from copy import deepcopy
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
import json
import random

from storyscenes.mini_adventures.local_play import LocalPlay
from storyscenes.runtime import StoryError
from .prose import render


@dataclass(frozen=True, kw_only=True)
class Parameters:
    seam_allowance: int = 1
    pins_available: bool = True
    teacher_available: bool = True
    minutes_left: int = 2
    mirror_clear: bool = True
    stage_lamp: bool = True

    def __post_init__(self):
        if type(self.seam_allowance) is not int or not 0 <= self.seam_allowance <= 2:
            raise ValueError("seam_allowance must be an integer in [0, 2]")
        if type(self.minutes_left) is not int or not 1 <= self.minutes_left <= 3:
            raise ValueError("minutes_left must be an integer in [1, 3]")
        for name in ("pins_available", "teacher_available", "mirror_clear", "stage_lamp"):
            if type(getattr(self, name)) is not bool:
                raise ValueError(f"{name} must be boolean")


def parameters(seed):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    return Parameters(
        seam_allowance=rng.choice((0, 1, 2)),
        pins_available=rng.choice((True, False)),
        teacher_available=rng.choice((True, False)),
        minutes_left=rng.choice((1, 2, 3)),
        mirror_clear=rng.choice((True, False)),
        stage_lamp=rng.choice((True, False)),
    )


def initial(params):
    if not isinstance(params, Parameters):
        raise TypeError("params must be a Parameters instance")
    state = {
        "story.started": False, "story.ended": False, "story.outcome": "",
        "place": "costume_cupboard", "ada.goal": "help Jo play the promised Storm role",
        "jo.promised_role": "Storm", "jo.spoke_up": False, "jo.label_seen": False,
        "jo.tunic_tried": False, "jo.tunic_attempted": False, "jo.costume": "moon_tunic",
        "jo.costume_fits": False, "jo.wears_costume": False, "jo.refitted": False,
        "jo.declined_tunic": False, "jo.saw_fit_issue": False, "jo.was_heard": False,
        "jo.performed": False, "jo.role_performed": "", "jo.performance_style": "",
        "jo.applause": False, "jo.plan": "",
        "teacher.available": params.teacher_available, "teacher.consulted": False,
        "teacher.answer": "unasked", "teacher.acknowledged": False,
        "minutes.start": params.minutes_left, "minutes.left": params.minutes_left,
        "costume.storm_reserved": False,
        "moon_tunic.location": "rack", "moon_tunic.design": "moon",
        "storm_coat.location": "teacher_rail" if params.teacher_available else "school_store",
        "pins.available": params.pins_available, "seam.allowance": params.seam_allowance,
        "cape.owner": "school", "cape.holder": "wardrobe", "cape.location": "cupboard_hook",
        "cape.borrowed": False, "cape.tested": False, "cape.used": False,
        "cape.use": "unused", "cape.returned": False,
        "mirror.clean": params.mirror_clear, "mirror.used": False,
        "ribbon.location": "drawer", "ribbon.chosen": False, "ribbon.used": False,
        "ribbon.returned": False, "rehearsal.ready": False,
        "performance.done": False,
    }
    validate(state)
    return state


def validate(state):
    required = {
        "story.started", "story.ended", "story.outcome", "place", "ada.goal",
        "jo.promised_role", "jo.spoke_up", "jo.label_seen", "jo.tunic_tried",
        "jo.tunic_attempted", "jo.costume", "jo.costume_fits", "jo.wears_costume",
        "jo.refitted", "jo.declined_tunic", "jo.saw_fit_issue", "jo.was_heard",
        "jo.performed", "jo.role_performed", "jo.performance_style", "jo.applause",
        "jo.plan", "teacher.available", "teacher.consulted", "teacher.answer",
        "teacher.acknowledged", "minutes.start", "minutes.left", "costume.storm_reserved",
        "moon_tunic.location", "moon_tunic.design", "storm_coat.location", "pins.available",
        "seam.allowance", "cape.owner", "cape.holder", "cape.location", "cape.borrowed",
        "cape.tested", "cape.used", "cape.use", "cape.returned", "mirror.clean",
        "mirror.used", "ribbon.location", "ribbon.chosen", "ribbon.used",
        "ribbon.returned", "rehearsal.ready", "performance.done",
    }
    missing = required - set(state)
    if missing:
        raise StoryError(f"Missing state keys: {sorted(missing)}")
    bools = ("story.started", "story.ended", "jo.spoke_up", "jo.label_seen", "jo.tunic_tried",
             "jo.tunic_attempted", "jo.costume_fits", "jo.wears_costume", "jo.refitted",
             "jo.declined_tunic", "jo.saw_fit_issue", "jo.was_heard", "jo.performed",
             "jo.applause", "teacher.available", "teacher.consulted", "teacher.acknowledged",
             "costume.storm_reserved", "pins.available", "cape.borrowed", "cape.tested",
             "cape.used", "cape.returned", "mirror.clean", "mirror.used", "ribbon.chosen",
             "ribbon.used", "ribbon.returned", "rehearsal.ready", "performance.done")
    for key in bools:
        if type(state[key]) is not bool:
            raise StoryError(f"{key} must be boolean")
    for key in ("minutes.start", "minutes.left", "seam.allowance"):
        if type(state[key]) is not int:
            raise StoryError(f"{key} must be an integer")
    strings = required - set(bools) - {"minutes.start", "minutes.left", "seam.allowance"}
    if any(not isinstance(state[key], str) for key in strings):
        raise StoryError("Text state values must be strings")
    if any(type(v) not in (str, bool, int, float) for v in state.values()):
        raise StoryError("State values must be JSON-native scalars")

    def need(condition, message):
        if not condition:
            raise StoryError(message)

    need(state["place"] in ("costume_cupboard", "backstage", "stage"), "Unknown location")
    need(state["jo.promised_role"] == "Storm", "The promised role changed")
    need(state["seam.allowance"] in (0, 1, 2), "Invalid seam allowance")
    need(state["minutes.start"] in (1, 2, 3), "Invalid starting time")
    need(0 <= state["minutes.left"] <= state["minutes.start"], "Invalid remaining time")
    need(state["cape.owner"] == "school", "The cape belongs to the school")
    need(state["cape.holder"] in ("wardrobe", "ada"), "Unknown cape holder")
    need(state["cape.use"] in ("unused", "wind_gust", "shadow", "wind_sail"), "Unknown cape use")
    need(state["cape.used"] == (state["cape.use"] != "unused"), "Cape use record disagrees")
    if state["cape.holder"] == "wardrobe":
        need(state["cape.location"] == "cupboard_hook" and not state["cape.borrowed"], "Cape custody disagrees")
        need(state["cape.returned"] == state["cape.used"], "Used cape must be returned")
    else:
        need(state["cape.location"] == "ada_hands" and state["cape.borrowed"] and not state["cape.returned"],
             "Borrowed cape custody disagrees")
    if state["cape.used"]:
        need(state["cape.tested"] and state["rehearsal.ready"], "Cape use needs the enacted rehearsal")
    need(state["moon_tunic.location"] in ("rack", "jo_hands", "jo"), "Unknown tunic location")
    need(state["storm_coat.location"] in ("teacher_rail", "school_store", "jo"), "Unknown Storm coat location")
    need(state["moon_tunic.design"] in ("moon", "storm"), "Unknown tunic design")
    if state["jo.costume"] == "storm_coat":
        need(state["jo.costume_fits"] and state["jo.wears_costume"], "Storm coat must fit when worn")
        need(state["storm_coat.location"] == "jo" and state["moon_tunic.location"] == "rack",
             "Costume exchange locations disagree")
        need(state["teacher.answer"] == "matching_coat", "No matching coat was offered")
    elif state["jo.costume"] == "moon_tunic":
        if state["jo.costume_fits"]:
            need(state["moon_tunic.design"] == "storm" and state["moon_tunic.location"] == "jo"
                 and state["jo.wears_costume"], "Altered tunic is not being worn")
        else:
            need(state["moon_tunic.design"] == "moon" and not state["jo.wears_costume"],
                 "An unsuitable tunic cannot be worn as a fit")
            need(state["moon_tunic.location"] in ("rack", "jo_hands"), "Unsuitable tunic is misplaced")
    else:
        raise StoryError("Unknown costume")
    if state["jo.refitted"] and not state["jo.costume_fits"]:
        need(state["jo.declined_tunic"] and state["moon_tunic.location"] == "rack",
             "An unfit costume must be declined and put back")
    if state["jo.costume_fits"]:
        need(state["jo.refitted"], "A fitting costume needs an enacted refit")
    if state["teacher.answer"] == "unasked":
        need(not state["teacher.consulted"] and state["minutes.left"] == state["minutes.start"],
             "Unasked teacher has no consultation cost")
    else:
        need(state["teacher.consulted"] and state["teacher.answer"] in ("matching_coat", "not_in_time"),
             "Invalid teacher answer")
        need(state["minutes.left"] == max(0, state["minutes.start"] - 1), "Consultation time was not recorded")
    if state["costume.storm_reserved"]:
        need(state["teacher.answer"] == "matching_coat" and state["storm_coat.location"] == "teacher_rail",
             "Reserved coat is unavailable")
    if state["teacher.answer"] == "matching_coat":
        need(state["teacher.available"] and state["minutes.start"] >= 2, "Coat appeared without time or teacher")
    if state["jo.tunic_attempted"]:
        need(state["teacher.consulted"] and state["teacher.answer"] == "not_in_time", "Seam test preceded the answer")
    if state["mirror.used"]:
        need(state["mirror.clean"] and state["story.started"] and state["jo.saw_fit_issue"], "Mirror scene incomplete")
    need(state["ribbon.location"] in ("drawer", "cape_edge"), "Unknown ribbon location")
    if state["ribbon.chosen"]:
        need(state["ribbon.location"] == ("drawer" if state["ribbon.returned"] else "cape_edge"),
             "Chosen ribbon is not with the cape or returned")
        need(state["ribbon.used"] == state["performance.done"], "Ribbon use must match the performance")
    else:
        need(state["ribbon.location"] == "drawer" and not state["ribbon.used"] and not state["ribbon.returned"],
             "Unchosen ribbon moved")
    if state["rehearsal.ready"]:
        need(state["jo.refitted"] and state["cape.used"] and state["place"] in ("backstage", "stage"),
             "Rehearsal lacks its preparation")
        need(state["jo.plan"] in ("storm_costume", "storm_shadow", "storm_sail"), "Missing performance plan")
    if state["place"] == "stage":
        need(state["rehearsal.ready"] and not state["performance.done"], "Invalid stage transition")
    if state["performance.done"]:
        need(state["place"] == "backstage" and state["jo.performed"] and state["jo.applause"],
             "Performance is incomplete")
        need(state["jo.role_performed"] == "Storm" and state["jo.performance_style"] == state["jo.plan"],
             "Performance does not match the rehearsal")
    else:
        need(state["jo.role_performed"] == "" and state["jo.performance_style"] == "", "Unperformed role recorded")
    need(state["story.ended"] == (state["story.outcome"] != ""), "Ending flag and outcome disagree")
    if state["story.ended"]:
        need(state["performance.done"] and state["cape.returned"] and state["jo.was_heard"]
             and state["teacher.acknowledged"] and state["place"] == "backstage", "Ending left a payoff unfinished")
        need(state["ribbon.returned"] == state["ribbon.chosen"], "Borrowed ribbon was not returned")
        expected = "storm_costume_restored" if state["jo.costume_fits"] else "storm_reimagined"
        need(state["story.outcome"] == expected, "Ending does not match the enacted outcome")
    else:
        need(state["story.outcome"] == "", "Premature outcome")


@dataclass(frozen=True, kw_only=True)
class Episode:
    id: str
    before: dict
    after: dict
    events: tuple[dict, ...]
    text: str


SCENES = (
    "opening", "borrow_cape", "mirror_vignette", "ribbon_vignette", "consult_teacher",
    "refit_costume", "rehearse", "performance", "ending_fit", "ending_improvised",
)
_OPTIONAL = {"mirror_vignette", "ribbon_vignette"}
_ENDINGS = {"ending_fit", "ending_improvised"}


def guard(scene_id, state):
    if scene_id not in SCENES:
        raise StoryError(f"Unknown scene: {scene_id}")
    validate(state)
    if state["story.ended"]:
        return False
    if scene_id == "opening":
        return not state["story.started"] and state["place"] == "costume_cupboard"
    if scene_id == "borrow_cape":
        return state["story.started"] and not state["cape.borrowed"] and state["place"] == "costume_cupboard"
    if scene_id == "mirror_vignette":
        return (state["story.started"] and not state["mirror.used"] and not state["teacher.consulted"]
                and state["place"] == "costume_cupboard")
    if scene_id == "ribbon_vignette":
        return (state["story.started"] and not state["ribbon.chosen"] and not state["teacher.consulted"]
                and state["place"] == "costume_cupboard")
    if scene_id == "consult_teacher":
        return (state["story.started"] and state["cape.borrowed"] and not state["teacher.consulted"]
                and state["place"] == "costume_cupboard")
    if scene_id == "refit_costume":
        return state["teacher.consulted"] and not state["jo.refitted"] and state["place"] == "costume_cupboard"
    if scene_id == "rehearse":
        return (state["jo.refitted"] and not state["rehearsal.ready"] and state["cape.borrowed"]
                and state["place"] == "costume_cupboard")
    if scene_id == "performance":
        return state["rehearsal.ready"] and not state["performance.done"] and state["place"] == "backstage"
    if scene_id == "ending_fit":
        return state["performance.done"] and state["jo.costume_fits"]
    if scene_id == "ending_improvised":
        return state["performance.done"] and not state["jo.costume_fits"]
    return False


def play_scene(params, state, scene_id):
    if not isinstance(params, Parameters):
        raise TypeError("params must be a Parameters instance")
    if scene_id not in SCENES or not guard(scene_id, state):
        raise StoryError(f"Scene not compatible with current state: {scene_id}")
    x = LocalPlay(state, actors=("Ada", "Jo"), validate=validate)

    if scene_id == "opening":
        x.act("try_on_moon_tunic", {"moon_tunic.location": "rack"},
              **{"moon_tunic.location": "jo_hands", "jo.tunic_tried": True})
        x.act("say_the_promise", {"jo.promised_role": "Storm"},
              **{"story.started": True, "jo.spoke_up": True, "jo.label_seen": True})
    elif scene_id == "borrow_cape":
        x.act("borrow_school_cape", {"cape.holder": "wardrobe"},
              **{"cape.holder": "ada", "cape.location": "ada_hands", "cape.borrowed": True})
        x.act("test_wind_with_cape", {"cape.borrowed": True}, **{"cape.tested": True})
    elif scene_id == "mirror_vignette":
        if not x.state["mirror.clean"]:
            x.act("wipe_cupboard_mirror", {"mirror.clean": False}, **{"mirror.clean": True})
        x.act("look_together", {"mirror.clean": True},
              **{"mirror.used": True, "jo.saw_fit_issue": True})
    elif scene_id == "ribbon_vignette":
        x.act("tie_silver_ribbon_to_cape", {"ribbon.location": "drawer"},
              **{"ribbon.location": "cape_edge", "ribbon.chosen": True})
    elif scene_id == "consult_teacher":
        available = x.state["teacher.available"] and x.state["minutes.left"] >= 2
        answer = "matching_coat" if available else "not_in_time"
        x.act("ask_about_storm_costume", {"teacher.consulted": False}, **{
            "teacher.consulted": True, "teacher.answer": answer,
            "costume.storm_reserved": available,
            "minutes.left": max(0, x.state["minutes.left"] - 1),
        })
    elif scene_id == "refit_costume":
        if x.state["teacher.answer"] == "matching_coat":
            x.act("exchange_for_fitting_storm_coat", {"costume.storm_reserved": True}, **{
                "jo.costume": "storm_coat", "jo.costume_fits": True, "jo.wears_costume": True,
                "jo.refitted": True, "storm_coat.location": "jo", "moon_tunic.location": "rack",
                "costume.storm_reserved": False,
            })
            x.act("agree_to_the_fit", {"jo.costume_fits": True}, **{"jo.declined_tunic": False})
        else:
            x.act("test_tunic_seam", {"jo.tunic_tried": True}, **{"jo.tunic_attempted": True})
            if x.state["seam.allowance"] >= 1 and x.state["pins.available"]:
                x.act("let_out_seam_with_pins", {
                    "jo.tunic_attempted": True, "pins.available": True,
                    "seam.allowance": x.state["seam.allowance"],
                }, **{
                    "jo.costume_fits": True, "jo.wears_costume": True, "jo.refitted": True,
                    "jo.declined_tunic": False, "moon_tunic.design": "storm",
                    "moon_tunic.location": "jo", "pins.available": False,
                })
            else:
                x.act("decline_the_tight_tunic", {"jo.tunic_attempted": True}, **{
                    "jo.refitted": True, "jo.declined_tunic": True, "moon_tunic.location": "rack",
                })
    elif scene_id == "rehearse":
        if x.state["jo.costume_fits"]:
            plan, use = "storm_costume", "wind_gust"
        elif params.stage_lamp:
            plan, use = "storm_shadow", "shadow"
        else:
            plan, use = "storm_sail", "wind_sail"
        x.act("build_the_storm_picture", {"cape.tested": True, "jo.refitted": True}, **{
            "jo.plan": plan, "cape.use": use, "cape.used": True,
            "rehearsal.ready": True, "place": "backstage",
        })
    elif scene_id == "performance":
        x.act("take_the_stage_cue", {"place": "backstage"}, **{"place": "stage"})
        changes = {
            "place": "backstage", "performance.done": True, "jo.performed": True,
            "jo.role_performed": "Storm", "jo.performance_style": x.state["jo.plan"],
            "jo.applause": True,
        }
        if x.state["ribbon.chosen"]:
            changes["ribbon.used"] = True
        x.act("perform_the_promised_storm", {"place": "stage", "rehearsal.ready": True}, **changes)
    elif scene_id in _ENDINGS:
        x.act("acknowledge_jo", {"performance.done": True}, **{
            "jo.was_heard": True, "teacher.acknowledged": True,
        })
        x.act("return_useful_borrowed_cape", {
            "cape.holder": "ada", "cape.used": True,
        }, **{
            "cape.holder": "wardrobe", "cape.location": "cupboard_hook",
            "cape.borrowed": False, "cape.returned": True,
        })
        if x.state["ribbon.chosen"]:
            x.act("return_silver_ribbon", {"ribbon.location": "cape_edge", "ribbon.used": True}, **{
                "ribbon.location": "drawer", "ribbon.returned": True,
            })
        outcome = "storm_costume_restored" if scene_id == "ending_fit" else "storm_reimagined"
        x.act("close_the_play", {"jo.was_heard": True}, **{
            "story.ended": True, "story.outcome": outcome,
        })

    after = deepcopy(x.state)
    validate(after)
    return Episode(
        id=scene_id, before=deepcopy(state), after=after,
        events=tuple(deepcopy(x.events)), text=render(scene_id, params, state, after),
    )


def _episode_dict(episode):
    return {
        "id": episode.id, "before": deepcopy(episode.before), "after": deepcopy(episode.after),
        "events": deepcopy(list(episode.events)), "text": episode.text,
    }


def _required_scenes(state):
    return sum((
        not state["story.started"], not state["cape.borrowed"], not state["teacher.consulted"],
        not state["jo.refitted"], not state["rehearsal.ready"], not state["performance.done"],
        not state["story.ended"],
    ))


def generate(seed=0, *, count=8, params=None):
    if type(seed) is not int:
        raise ValueError("seed must be an integer")
    if type(count) is not int or count not in (7, 8):
        raise ValueError("count must be exactly 7 or 8")
    p = params if params is not None else parameters(seed)
    if not isinstance(p, Parameters):
        raise TypeError("params must be a Parameters instance")
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    attempts = 0
    budget = 5000

    def search(state, episodes):
        nonlocal attempts
        remaining = count - len(episodes)
        needed = _required_scenes(state)
        if remaining < needed or remaining > needed + 1:
            return None
        if remaining > needed and not any(guard(s, state) for s in _OPTIONAL if s not in {e.id for e in episodes}):
            return None
        if remaining == 0:
            return episodes if state["story.ended"] else None
        used = {e.id for e in episodes}
        choices = [s for s in SCENES if s not in used and guard(s, state)]
        rng.shuffle(choices)
        for scene_id in choices:
            if scene_id in _ENDINGS and remaining != 1:
                continue
            attempts += 1
            if attempts > budget:
                raise StoryError(f"Bounded scene search exhausted ({budget} attempts)")
            episode = play_scene(p, state, scene_id)
            answer = search(episode.after, episodes + (episode,))
            if answer is not None:
                return answer
        return None

    episodes = search(initial(p), ())
    if episodes is None:
        raise StoryError("No compatible complete route at the requested length")
    episode_rows = [_episode_dict(e) for e in episodes]
    return {
        "seed": seed, "parameters": asdict(p), "scene_count": count,
        "path": [e.id for e in episodes],
        "story": "\n\n".join(e.text for e in episodes),
        "episodes": episode_rows, "final_state": deepcopy(episodes[-1].after),
        "search_attempts": attempts,
    }


def replay(params, path):
    if not isinstance(params, Parameters):
        raise TypeError("params must be a Parameters instance")
    state = initial(params)
    episodes = []
    for scene_id in path:
        if scene_id in {episode.id for episode in episodes}:
            raise StoryError(f"A scene cannot be repeated: {scene_id}")
        episode = play_scene(params, state, scene_id)
        episodes.append(episode)
        state = episode.after
    return tuple(episodes)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=0)
    parser.add_argument("--scenes", type=int, choices=(7, 8), default=8)
    parser.add_argument("--params", help="JSON object overriding generated Parameters")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    overrides = json.loads(args.params) if args.params else {}
    if not isinstance(overrides, dict):
        parser.error("--params must be a JSON object")
    try:
        p = Parameters(**(asdict(parameters(args.seed)) | overrides))
        row = generate(args.seed, count=args.scenes, params=p)
    except (TypeError, ValueError, StoryError) as exc:
        parser.error(str(exc))
    print(row["story"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def render(scene_id, params, before, after):
    if scene_id == "opening":
        return (
            "Ada had been trusted to keep the costume cupboard in order. Jo found her name crossed out "
            "beside STORM and a gold tunic marked MOON. She tried it at one shoulder; the seam pinched. "
            "‘I was promised Storm,’ Jo said. Ada looked from the label to her friend. ‘Then let's make "
            "them listen.’"
        )
    if scene_id == "borrow_cape":
        return (
            "The school cape hung on a high hook. Ada borrowed it, writing her name on the return card. "
            "She unfurled one corner. It made a soft rush that lifted the paper stars. ‘That could be our "
            "wind,’ she said. Jo smiled. Ada still held the cape; borrowing it had given their play a cue, "
            "not a new owner."
        )
    if scene_id == "mirror_vignette":
        if before["mirror.clean"]:
            return (
                "Jo stood before the clear mirror with the gold tunic held against her shoulder. The crossed-out "
                "Storm label showed behind her. ‘I look like the Moon, and not a comfortable one,’ she said. "
                "Ada watched Jo's face instead of offering a quick fix. ‘You still want Storm?’ ‘More than "
                "this,’ Jo answered."
            )
        return (
            "Fingerprints clouded the cupboard mirror, so Ada wiped a clean patch with her sleeve. Jo held "
            "the gold tunic against her shoulder; the crossed-out Storm label appeared behind her reflection. "
            "‘I look like the Moon, and not a comfortable one,’ she said. ‘You still want Storm?’ Ada asked. "
            "‘More than this,’ Jo replied."
        )
    if scene_id == "ribbon_vignette":
        return (
            "In the notions drawer, Jo found a thin silver ribbon. She tied it to the cape's clasp rather than "
            "the tight tunic. ‘A little moonlight for the storm,’ she said. Ada let Jo choose the detail. "
            "The ribbon stayed on the borrowed cape, ready to catch the stage light; it would go back to its "
            "drawer after the performance."
        )
    if scene_id == "consult_teacher":
        if after["teacher.answer"] == "matching_coat":
            return (
                "Ada found Mrs Bell at the doorway and showed her the crossed-out label. ‘Jo was promised "
                "Storm. Is there another costume?’ Mrs Bell checked the rail and brought over a roomy storm "
                "coat. ‘I'm sorry I missed this.’ Jo inspected the sleeves before taking it. ‘This one fits.’ "
                "They had time to try it before places."
            )
        return (
            "Ada found Mrs Bell carrying scenery boards and showed her the crossed-out label. Mrs Bell "
            "looked toward the assembly hall. ‘The right coat is over there, but it won't reach us before "
            "places.’ Jo spoke up: ‘I was promised Storm. Please don't change my part without asking.’ "
            "Mrs Bell apologized and hurried away; no missing costume appeared in the cupboard."
        )
    if scene_id == "refit_costume":
        if after["jo.costume_fits"] and after["jo.costume"] == "storm_coat":
            return (
                "Mrs Bell's storm coat was roomy at the shoulders and long enough for Jo to move. Jo raised "
                "both arms, then turned once. ‘I can breathe and still look like weather.’ Ada hung the "
                "pinching Moon tunic back on its rail. The promised role had its proper costume at last, "
                "because Jo had asked and the teacher had listened."
            )
        if after["jo.costume_fits"]:
            return (
                "The pin tin held just enough to let out the tunic's seam. Jo checked the loosened shoulder, "
                "then wore the altered gold cloth as a Storm costume instead of a Moon one. ‘It fits now, "
                "and the label can stop arguing,’ she said. Ada put the used pins safely aside. Jo had "
                "helped decide what the repair was for."
            )
        return (
            "The tunic's seam had no room, and the pin tin was empty. Ada began to suggest a quick fix, but "
            "Jo stepped back. ‘No pinning me into a part. I want Storm, not a costume that hurts.’ She put "
            "the Moon tunic on its rail. Ada listened. The costume still did not fit, but Jo's part was not "
            "being taken away."
        )
    if scene_id == "rehearse":
        if after["jo.plan"] == "storm_costume":
            detail = " The silver ribbon flashed at the clasp." if before["ribbon.chosen"] else ""
            return (
                "Backstage, Jo tested the sleeves while Ada swept the cape through the air. The fitted coat "
                "gave Jo room to turn; the cape made a gust on her cue. ‘Wait for my line,’ Jo said. Ada "
                "nodded and tried again, this time letting Jo lead the weather." + detail
            )
        if after["jo.plan"] == "storm_shadow":
            detail = " The silver ribbon winked at the edge." if before["ribbon.chosen"] else ""
            return (
                "The work lamp threw a bright square onto the scenery cloth. Ada raised the cape as a screen, "
                "and Jo practiced the Storm lines behind its moving shadow. ‘Not too fast,’ Jo said. Ada "
                "slowed the sweep until the dark shape rolled like a cloud." + detail
            )
        detail = " The silver ribbon flickered in the work light." if before["ribbon.chosen"] else ""
        return (
            "With no useful shadow from the work lamp, Ada and Jo made the cape a moving storm sail. Jo "
            "stamped out the thunder rhythm while Ada caught the cloth's edge. ‘On my word,’ Jo said. Ada "
            "waited, then sent a gust across the scenery. The cape had a job, and Jo had the cue." + detail
        )
    if scene_id == "performance":
        if after["jo.performance_style"] == "storm_costume":
            return (
                "The play paused for the Storm cue. Jo stepped forward in the coat that fit and spoke her "
                "lines without tugging at a seam. Ada swept the borrowed cape on the beat Jo had rehearsed. "
                "The wind crossed the painted sky; the audience clapped as the scene turned. Jo had played "
                "the role she was promised."
            )
        if after["jo.performance_style"] == "storm_shadow":
            return (
                "At the Storm cue, Jo stood behind the cape's shadow and spoke clearly into the hall. Ada "
                "moved the cloth across the lit scenery, and the dark shape rolled over the painted town. "
                "Jo's voice carried the thunder; the cape gave it weather. The audience followed the scene, "
                "not the costume label."
            )
        return (
            "At the Storm cue, Jo stamped a thunder rhythm and called the wind. Ada sent the borrowed cape "
            "sailing across the bright scenery cloth. It was not a fitted costume or a trick shadow, but the "
            "audience heard the weather in Jo's voice and saw it in the moving fabric. The hall answered "
            "with applause."
        )
    if scene_id == "ending_fit":
        return (
            "After the bow, Mrs Bell thanked Jo for speaking up and promised to correct the cast list. Jo "
            "kept the fitting Storm coat for the next scene. Ada returned the cape to its hook; its wind cue "
            "had helped the play, and school still owned it. ‘We fixed the costume and kept the part,’ Jo "
            "said. Ada agreed. The curtain was down, and their work was finished."
        )
    if scene_id == "ending_improvised":
        return (
            "After the bow, Mrs Bell apologized without making an excuse. Jo had played Storm without wearing "
            "the pinching Moon tunic. Ada returned the cape to its hook; its shadow or gust had carried the "
            "weather, and school still owned it. ‘That was my part,’ Jo said. ‘It was,’ Ada answered. The "
            "play was over, and Jo had not been made smaller to fit the wrong costume."
        )
    raise ValueError(f"No prose for scene: {scene_id}")
"},{"path":"storyscenes/mini_adventures/kite/test_world.py","content":"from copy import deepcopy
from dataclasses import asdict
import json
import subprocess
import sys
import unittest

from storyscenes.runtime import StoryError
from .world import Parameters, SCENES, generate, guard, initial, play_scene, replay, validate


OPTIONAL = {"mirror_vignette", "ribbon_vignette"}


class StormCostumeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def assert_row_replays(self, row):
        p = Parameters(**row["parameters"])
        episodes = replay(p, row["path"])
        serialized = [asdict(e) | {"events": list(e.events)} for e in episodes]
        self.assertEqual(serialized, row["episodes"])
        self.assertEqual(episodes[-1].after, row["final_state"])
        self.assertEqual("\n\n".join(e.text for e in episodes), row["story"])
        self.assertEqual(len(row["path"]), row["scene_count"])
        self.assertEqual(len(set(row["path"])), len(row["path"]))
        state = initial(p)
        for episode in episodes:
            self.assertEqual(state, episode.before)
            self.assertTrue(guard(episode.id, state))
            for event in episode.events:
                self.assertTrue(event["action"])
                self.assertTrue(event["changes"])
                for key, value in event["requires"].items():
                    self.assertEqual(state[key], value)
                for key, changes in event["changes"].items():
                    self.assertEqual(state[key], changes["before"])
                    self.assertNotEqual(changes["before"], changes["after"])
                    state[key] = changes["after"]
                validate(state)
            self.assertEqual(state, episode.after)
            words = len(episode.text.split())
            self.assertGreaterEqual(words, 40)
            self.assertLessEqual(words, 70)
        self.assertIs(row["final_state"]["story.ended"], True)
        self.assertTrue(row["final_state"]["story.outcome"])

    def test_both_lengths_over_one_hundred_seeds_and_exact_replay(self):
        for seed in range(100):
            for count in (7, 8):
                with self.subTest(seed=seed, count=count):
                    row = generate(seed, count=count)
                    self.assert_row_replays(row)
                    self.assertEqual(set(row["path"]) & {"ending_fit", "ending_improvised"},
                                     {row["path"][-1]})

    def test_optional_vignettes_are_optional_and_have_no_offstage_effects(self):
        p = Parameters()
        seven = generate(4, count=7, params=p)
        eight = generate(4, count=8, params=p)
        self.assertFalse(set(seven["path"]) & OPTIONAL)
        self.assertEqual(len(set(eight["path"]) & OPTIONAL), 1)
        start = initial(p)
        after_opening = play_scene(p, start, "opening").after
        saved = deepcopy(after_opening)
        mirror = play_scene(p, after_opening, "mirror_vignette")
        self.assertEqual(after_opening, saved)
        self.assertTrue(mirror.after["mirror.used"])
        self.assertTrue(mirror.after["jo.saw_fit_issue"])
        ribbon = play_scene(p, play_scene(p, after_opening, "borrow_cape").after, "ribbon_vignette")
        self.assertEqual(ribbon.after["ribbon.location"], "cape_edge")
        self.assertEqual(ribbon.after["cape.holder"], "ada")
        self.assertFalse(after_opening["ribbon.chosen"])

    def test_each_ending_has_an_explicit_parameter_recipe(self):
        fixed = Parameters(teacher_available=True, minutes_left=2)
        improvised = Parameters(teacher_available=False, minutes_left=1,
                                seam_allowance=0, pins_available=False)
        a = generate(11, count=7, params=fixed)
        b = generate(11, count=7, params=improvised)
        self.assertEqual(a["path"][-1], "ending_fit")
        self.assertEqual(a["final_state"]["story.outcome"], "storm_costume_restored")
        self.assertEqual(b["path"][-1], "ending_improvised")
        self.assertEqual(b["final_state"]["story.outcome"], "storm_reimagined")
        self.assertNotEqual(a["final_state"]["jo.performance_style"],
                            b["final_state"]["jo.performance_style"])

    def test_parameter_counterfactuals_change_the_enacted_local_play(self):
        ready = Parameters(teacher_available=True, minutes_left=2, stage_lamp=True)
        no_coat = Parameters(teacher_available=False, minutes_left=1, seam_allowance=0,
                             pins_available=False, stage_lamp=False)
        a = replay(ready, ("opening", "borrow_cape", "consult_teacher", "refit_costume"))[-1]
        b = replay(no_coat, ("opening", "borrow_cape", "consult_teacher", "refit_costume"))[-1]
        self.assertTrue(a.after["jo.costume_fits"])
        self.assertFalse(b.after["jo.costume_fits"])
        self.assertIn("exchange_for_fitting_storm_coat", [e["action"] for e in a.events])
        self.assertIn("decline_the_tight_tunic", [e["action"] for e in b.events])
        self.assertEqual(b.after["minutes.left"], 0)

    def test_mirror_and_stage_lamp_parameters_have_local_effects(self):
        dusty = Parameters(mirror_clear=False)
        state = play_scene(dusty, initial(dusty), "opening").after
        mirror = play_scene(dusty, state, "mirror_vignette")
        self.assertIn("wipe_cupboard_mirror", [e["action"] for e in mirror.events])
        dark_lamp = Parameters(teacher_available=False, minutes_left=1, seam_allowance=0,
                               pins_available=False, stage_lamp=False)
        path = ("opening", "borrow_cape", "consult_teacher", "refit_costume", "rehearse")
        rehearsal = replay(dark_lamp, path)[-1]
        self.assertEqual(rehearsal.after["jo.plan"], "storm_sail")
        self.assertEqual(rehearsal.after["cape.use"], "wind_sail")

    def test_illegal_actions_fail_without_mutating_the_caller(self):
        p = Parameters()
        state = initial(p)
        saved = deepcopy(state)
        with self.assertRaises(StoryError):
            play_scene(p, state, "borrow_cape")
        self.assertEqual(state, saved)
        opened = play_scene(p, state, "opening").after
        saved_opened = deepcopy(opened)
        with self.assertRaises(StoryError):
            play_scene(p, opened, "performance")
        self.assertEqual(opened, saved_opened)
        with self.assertRaises(StoryError):
            play_scene(p, opened, "opening")
        self.assertEqual(opened, saved_opened)

    def test_borrowed_object_and_costume_locations_remain_consistent(self):
        p = Parameters(teacher_available=False, minutes_left=1, seam_allowance=0, pins_available=False)
        row = generate(2, count=8, params=p)
        states = [row["episodes"][0]["before"]] + [e["after"] for e in row["episodes"]]
        borrowed = [s for s in states if s["cape.borrowed"]]
        self.assertTrue(borrowed)
        self.assertTrue(all(s["cape.holder"] == "ada" and s["cape.location"] == "ada_hands" for s in borrowed))
        final = row["final_state"]
        self.assertEqual(final["cape.owner"], "school")
        self.assertEqual(final["cape.holder"], "wardrobe")
        self.assertEqual(final["cape.location"], "cupboard_hook")
        self.assertTrue(final["cape.used"])
        self.assertTrue(final["cape.returned"])
        self.assertFalse(final["jo.wears_costume"])
        self.assertEqual(final["jo.role_performed"], "Storm")

    def test_scene_ids_and_invalid_parameters(self):
        self.assertEqual(len(SCENES), len(set(SCENES)))
        for kwargs in (
            {"seam_allowance": True}, {"seam_allowance": 3}, {"minutes_left": 0},
            {"pins_available": 1}, {"teacher_available": "yes"}, {"mirror_clear": 0},
        ):
            with self.subTest(kwargs=kwargs), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                Parameters(**kwargs)
        for count in (True, 6, 9):
            with self.subTest(count=count), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                generate(0, count=count)
        with self.assertRaises(StoryError):
            replay(Parameters(), ("opening", "opening"))
        with self.assertRaises(StoryError):
            guard("not_a_scene", initial(Parameters()))

These recipes are independent of the random seed and work at either supported length:

Generated stories contain exactly seven or eight compatible scenes. Seven-scene routes use the core encounters; eight-scene routes include one of the two optional vignettes. The bounded seeded search commits only selected scenes; rejected speculative routes do not alter state or appear in the trace. The cape remains school property, its wind/shadow use is recorded, and it is returned after the performance. A chosen ribbon is also returned. The scene prose is authored per encounter and conditioned on enacted outcomes, not assembled from whole-story variants.
